card.name: Just before HIV or AIDS appears
card.fires_on: The word or letter right before HIV or AIDS is spelled out, such as the H in HIV, the A in AIDS, an opening bracket, or 'with' after patients. It is strongest when the next word is HIV or AIDS.

modes.label: Opening letter of HIV/AIDS
modes.description: The first letter H or A of the acronym, often in brackets after the spelled-out name.

modes.label: Inside antiretroviral

card.writes: It makes the model expect HIV or AIDS next, and lowers the chance of those words (and their Chinese forms) being written.
